uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Map Pins on this device. "Like Foundry" follows Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature shows the windows on warm paper, Foundry keeps them dark like the rest of Foundry.

labelMode.name: Pin labels
labelMode.hint: When the name of a pin is shown. A pin can choose for itself in its note settings.
labelMode.hover: Only when the pointer is on the pin

noBackground.name: Pins without the dark box
noBackground.hint: Show only the symbol of a pin, without the dark box and frame behind it.

constantSize.name: Pins keep their size when zooming
constantSize.hint: Pins stay as big on the screen as you set below, however far you zoom in or out.

constantScale.name: Size on the screen (percent)
constantScale.hint: Only for pins that keep their size. 100 is the size set in the note.

minZoom.name: Hide pins when zoomed out below (percent)
minZoom.hint: Pins disappear when the map is zoomed out further than this. 0 never hides them.

numberFromName.name: Take pin numbers from journal names
numberFromName.hint: A journal called "12. Hall" gives its pin the number 12 and the label "Hall".

autoNumber.name: Number new pins automatically
autoNumber.hint: A new pin gets the next free number.

preview.name: Preview when the pointer rests on a pin
preview.hint: A card with the title, the first picture and the first lines of the journal. It shows only what the user may read.

previewChars.name: Length of the preview text (characters)
previewChars.hint: How much text the preview card shows at most.

newGlobal.name: New pins are visible without line of sight
newGlobal.hint: A new pin is marked as global, so players see it without a token that can see it.

notesOn.name: Show pins to players
notesOn.hint: Switches Foundry's pin display on for every player. A player can still switch it off for themselves later. Turning this option on again applies it to everybody.

playerPins.name: Pins set by players
playerPins.hint: Players set a pin with a name and a text. The GM writes it, because Foundry does not let players create notes.

playerPinsPrivate.name: Players may set pins only they see
playerPinsPrivate.hint: Their name and text stay on the player's device. See the manual for what other players' browsers still receive.

playerPinLimit.name: Most pins per player and scene
playerPinLimit.hint: Stops a player from filling a map.

discoverDefault.name: New pins are hidden until discovered
discoverDefault.hint: A new pin starts hidden: players do not see it until they discover it.

discoverAuto.name: Players discover pins by exploring
discoverAuto.hint: A hidden pin appears for a player when its place is in explored ground of the map or in sight. Needs token vision and fog exploration on the scene. Reveals by Sephral's Map Knowledge count too.

discoverPing.name: Ping and note when a pin appears
discoverPing.hint: A player sees a ping at the pin and a short note.

keyText.name: Text in the map key
keyText.hint: What each page of the map key holds besides the title and the link.
keyText.title: Only title and link

pace.name: Travel pace
pace.hint: The pace used for the travel time of routes.

paceSlow.name: Slow pace (units per hour)
paceSlow.hint: The distance a party covers in an hour, in the units of the scene (miles, kilometers and so on). Set it for the scale of your maps.

paceNormal.name: Normal pace (units per hour)
paceNormal.hint: The distance a party covers in an hour, in the units of the scene (miles, kilometers and so on). Set it for the scale of your maps.

paceFast.name: Fast pace (units per hour)
paceFast.hint: The distance a party covers in an hour, in the units of the scene (miles, kilometers and so on). Set it for the scale of your maps.

hoursPerDay.name: Hours of travel per day
hoursPerDay.hint: A day of travel counts this many hours when the travel time is shown in days.

routePlayers.name: Players can build routes
routePlayers.hint: Players pick pins for a route of their own that only they see. A route you share with players is always shown.

whereOn.name: Show where the party is
whereOn.hint: Marks the pin that opens the party's scene on the maps above it, and adds the control Where are we? to the notes controls.

partyTrail.name: Keep a trail of visited places
partyTrail.hint: The active GM notes every place the party arrives at, with the world time. The trail is drawn on the map above, for players only at pins they may see.

List.title: Pin List
List.menuHint: All pins of the viewed scene with search and category filter.
List.numbers: Number the pins of this scene
List.private: Only for the one who set it

size.constant: Keeps its size on the screen

Config.title: Map Pins
Config.imageHint: The image of the pin, set in the icon section above.
Config.label: Label
Config.minZoomHint: In percent. Empty follows the world setting, 0 never hides this pin.
Config.numberHint: A number or short code like 12 or B3. Empty shows no number.
Config.previewTextHint: Replaces the first lines of the journal in the preview.
Config.sceneHint: A double click switches the view to this scene instead of opening the journal.
Config.hiddenHint: Players do not see this pin until they explore its place on the map or you reveal it.
Config.questHint: Shows a small mark on the pin: open, done or failed.

Categories.title: Pin Categories
Categories.menuHint: The world's categories with symbol and color, for example quest, shop or danger.
Categories.hint: A pin in a category gets a ring in its color, and its symbol when the pin has no image of its own. Players can hide categories for themselves in the pin list.
Categories.name: Name

Numbers.title: Number the pins
Numbers.keepHint: Pins with a number keep it, the others take the free numbers.
Numbers.fromNamesHint: A pin whose name starts with a number like "12." gets that number.

Migrate.title: Take over older pins
Migrate.menuHint: Takes the label, background and preview text an older pin module left on your pins. Its data is only read.
Migrate.intro: Takes over from an older pin module: label always visible, background, preview text and picture.
Migrate.hint: Nothing is deleted. Settings a pin already has here are not replaced.

Open.sceneGone: The linked scene does not exist any more.

Player.pick: Click the map where the pin goes. Escape cancels.
Player.name: Name
Player.visibilityHint: A pin only for you keeps its name and text on this device.
Player.otherDevice: The text of this pin is on the device where you set it.
Player.confirmText: {user} wants to set this pin on "{scene}":

fail.noGM: No GM is online, so the pin cannot be set now.
fail.off: Pins by players are switched off.
fail.gone: That pin does not exist any more.
fail.invalid: The pin could not be set there.
fail.limit: You have set the most pins allowed on this scene.
fail.error: The pin could not be saved.
fail.unknown: The pin could not be set.

SELFTEST.Title: Self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks after an update that everything the module relies on is there.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Foundry is newer than the verified version ({versions}). Run the self test if something looks wrong.
SELFTEST.Note: Foundry's note class lacks parts Map Pins relies on.
SELFTEST.Pixi: The text or drawing classes of the map are missing.
SELFTEST.Toggle: Foundry's setting for showing pins is missing.
SELFTEST.Preview: The safe preview text keeps secrets or scripts. Do not use the preview card.
SELFTEST.Icon: The pin icons of Foundry are built differently than expected.
SELFTEST.Fog: The fog of war of Foundry is built differently than expected. Pins cannot be discovered by exploring.
SELFTEST.Route: The route cannot be drawn or measured.
SELFTEST.Key: The pages of a map key cannot be made.
SELFTEST.Party: Where the party is, or the chain of maps above it, gives wrong results.
SELFTEST.Area: Areas (Foundry drawings) are built differently than expected.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: One file about all of Sephral's modules in this world, for bug reports. It contains chat text and whispers.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file saved: {file}. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.

Reveal.title: Reveal pin
Reveal.hint: Players do not see this pin until they explore its place or you reveal it. Tick the players who should see it. Players you leave unticked do not see it.
Reveal.hintVisible: This pin is not hidden yet. Revealing makes it a hidden pin that only the players you choose can see.
Reveal.noPlayers: There are no players in this world.

Key.name: Map key: {scene}
Key.title: Map key
Key.intro: Creates a journal with one page for each of the {count} numbered pins of {scene}, in number order.
Key.introUpdate: Updates the map key journal of {scene} for the {count} numbered pins. Only the generated part of each page is rewritten, what you added stays.
Key.hint: Pins without a number are left out. Secret parts of journals never appear.

Route.title: Route
Route.picking: Picking: click the pins in order
Route.emptyBuild: No pins in the route yet. Pick pins on the map or use the route button in the pin list.
Route.emptyView: The GM has not shared a route.
Route.sharedHint: Players see this route as a dashed line on the map and in this window, up to the first pin they have not discovered.
Route.unavailable: There is no route to show.

Where.title: Where are we?
Where.nobody: Nobody knows where the party is yet.
Where.noMap: The party's place is on none of the maps you can see.
Where.sourceHint: The GM can set the place by hand. Otherwise it is the scene all online players look at, else the active scene.
Where.clearText: Remove all places from the trail?
Where.noPicture: This map has no picture to show.
Where.empty: No map you can see has a pin for this place.

Area.noRights: You may not read this journal.
Area.title: Area
Area.isAreaHint: An area has a category, a journal and a preview on hover, and it shows in the pin list.
Area.previewTextHint: Shown in the preview instead of the first lines of the journal.
Area.hiddenHint: Players do not see this area until they explore its ground or you reveal it. Foundry hides the drawing too.
Area.name: Name
Area.shapeHint: Pick a shape, then draw it on the map. The name becomes the large label.
Area.draw: Draw the area {name} on the map. Finish a polygon with a double click.
